schoolDescriptions.description: The University of the Philippines Diliman is a public university campus in Quezon City offering undergraduate and graduate education across a wide range of disciplines.

The Polytechnic University of the Philippines is a public university whose main campus is in Santa Mesa, Manila. It offers programs in business, technology, engineering, education and other disciplines.
Ateneo de Manila University is a private Jesuit university in Quezon City, with undergraduate programs and professional and graduate education.
STI College Pasay-EDSA is an STI campus in Pasay City offering senior high school and tertiary programs in computing, accounting information systems, hospitality and tourism.
STI College Ortigas-Cainta is an STI campus in Cainta, Rizal offering senior high school and tertiary programs. This campus is outside Metro Manila.
